packages.name: Atliso-LapsRotationAudit
packages.title: Atliso-LapsRotationAudit
packages.description:
Windows LAPS can report as compliant in Intune while the local admin password
hasn't actually rotated in months. This script confirms whether a successful
password backup was logged inside the expected window, and if not, forces a
rotation with Reset-LapsPassword.

Detection signal: event 10029 (Entra ID backup) or 10018 (Active Directory backup)
in the Microsoft-Windows-LAPS/Operational channel, logged inside
PasswordAgeDays + GraceDays. It also flags event 10005 (policy processing failed),
which means rotation is actively failing rather than just late.

Runs audit-only by default (-WhatIf $true). Set -WhatIf $false to force rotation.

Intune usage: deploy as a Remediation. The detection half exits 1 when no
successful backup is confirmed inside the window. Run as SYSTEM, 64-bit.

packages.name: Atliso-Win11EndOfSupportAudit
packages.title: Atliso-Win11EndOfSupportAudit
packages.description:
Lists every Intune-managed Windows device with its version, edition and the last day of
security updates for that edition, and exports the result to CSV.

Windows 11 support is split by edition, not by build. 24H2 is build 26100 on every edition,
but Home and Pro lose support on 13 October 2026 while Enterprise and Education keep it until
12 October 2027, and LTSC 2024 (also 26100) runs to 2029, or 2034 for IoT Enterprise. Filtering
Intune by OS version alone gives the wrong list. This script works out the date per device.

Read-only: it signs in with your own account and only reads Intune's managed devices.
Nothing in your tenant is changed, so there is no WhatIf switch.

Guide: https://atliso.com/blog/windows-11-24h2-end-of-support-intune
